Flight Planning

Exigence De Montée À L'approche

The minimum climb gradient that an aircraft must meet during the missed approach phase, considering one engine inoperative.

Quick answer: The minimum climb gradient that an aircraft must meet during the missed approach phase, considering one engine inoperative.

Questions and answers

What is Exigence De Montée À L'approche?

In this glossary, Exigence De Montée À L'approche refers to: The minimum climb gradient that an aircraft must meet during the missed approach phase, considering one engine inoperative.

How is Exigence De Montée À L'approche used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tour, confirmez que l'appareil satisfait à l'exigence de montée à l'approche avec un moteur inopérant."

Definition
